name: @herbertgao/pi-extensions-workspace
description: HerbertGao-maintained extensions for the Pi coding agent
author: Herbert Gao

scripts.format: oxfmt . && bun run --cwd packages/pi-cc-extensions format && bun run --cwd packages/resume-from format
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check . && bun run --cwd packages/pi-cc-extensions format:check && bun run --cwd packages/resume-from format:check
scripts.lint: oxlint . && bun run --cwd packages/pi-subagents lint && bun run --cwd packages/resume-from lint
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/pi-subagents typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/pi-cc-extensions typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/resume-from typecheck
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && bun run --cwd packages/pi-subagents test && bun run --cwd packages/pi-cc-extensions test && bun run --cwd packages/resume-from test
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:aggregate && bun run check:upstreams
